dedupe_keys.name: seasonal crop yield forecast verification metrics for ghana kenya and zimbabwe

description: Wageningen researchers provide verification metrics and reporting outputs for LPJmL seasonal crop-yield hindcasts in Ghana, Kenya and Zimbabwe. The source lists CRPSS, RPSS and ROC-AUC scores. Hindcasts forced with bias-corrected ECMWF SEAS5 forecasts are compared against an ERA5-Land-forced reference simulation. Results are separated by crop, initialisation month and lead time. The custom time field specifies 1994 to 2023. Coverage: 1994-2023 Access: public native metadata describes the release and its formats. Licence: CC-BY-SA-4.0. Cost and current distribution access remain unknown. Caveats: The reference is another simulation, not observed harvest yields. The metrics complement the separately catalogued Foodshed hindcast and reference resources. Files and scoring accuracy were not independently checked.
